author: mfhansen
title: LLM accuracy tests fail with TypeError: genai_gen_text() got an unexpected keyword argument 'context'
signature: typeerror genai_gen_text got an unexpected keyword argument context|Dependencies

failed_jobs.name: LLM accuracy iGPU tests / LLM accuracy GPU tests
failed_jobs.symptom: All 4 GPU accuracy_conformance test cases fail with TypeError calling genai_gen_text(context=...)

failed_jobs.name: LLM accuracy CPU tests / LLM accuracy CPU tests
failed_jobs.symptom: All 4 CPU accuracy_conformance test cases fail with TypeError calling genai_gen_text(context=...)

key_errors:
File "/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/whowhatbench/text_evaluator.py", line 236, in _generate_data
    output = gen_answer_fn(
TypeError: genai_gen_text() got an unexpected keyword argument 'context'
FAILED tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py::test_accuracy_conformance[TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0-INT8-CPU] - TypeError: genai_gen_text() got an unexpected keyword argument 'context'
root_cause: The installed `whowhatbench` package's text_evaluator._generate_data() calls the GenAI generation callback with a `context` keyword argument, but the `genai_gen_text()` function bundled with the installed `optimum-intel`/`openvino-genai` wheel set does not accept that parameter. This is a dependency version-skew issue between whowhatbench and the GenAI model-loader helper it invokes, not something introduced by PR #39512 (which only edits a benchmarks CSV file under docs/). The same signature has recurred 5 times since 2026-11-05, consistently affecting both CPU and GPU LLM accuracy jobs, confirming a pinned-dependency incompatibility rather than a transient or PR-specific issue.
reproduction_steps: 1. Check out the merge-queue commit. 2. Install test deps per tests/llm/requirements.txt (same resolved versions as in the CI log, e.g. optimum-intel-2.0.0, openvino-genai-2026.4.1.0, whowhatbench 1.0.0.dev0). 3. Run `python3 -m pytest tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py -k CPU --tb native`. 4. Observe TypeError: genai_gen_text() got an unexpected keyword argument 'context' raised from whowhatbench/text_evaluator.py:236.
recommended_actions: Pin or bump whowhatbench to a version whose text_evaluator._generate_data() matches the current genai_gen_text() signature (or vice versa pin genai_gen_text()'s providing package to accept 'context').

Inspect the model-loader helper that defines genai_gen_text() (resolved from optimum-intel/openvino-genai in tests/llm/requirements.txt) and add the missing 'context' parameter if whowhatbench's newer API is the one to keep.
Add a CI smoke check that fails fast on signature mismatches between whowhatbench and the GenAI loader helpers before full accuracy runs.
prevention_strategies: Pin whowhatbench, optimum-intel and openvino-genai together in tests/llm/requirements.txt with compatible version ranges, and add a unit test that calls genai_gen_text() directly with the exact kwargs whowhatbench's text_evaluator passes, so an incompatible upgrade fails fast in CI instead of surfacing only in the LLM accuracy jobs.
historical_context: Identical signature (6cf9cf0d8f5c0a43) previously recorded 4 times between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-10 (runs 41968975027, 42251178965, 42647164506, 42857529315), always in the LLM accuracy CPU/GPU jobs and always categorized Dependencies. This run raises the count to 5, confirming an unresolved, recurring dependency-version-skew issue rather than a one-off flake.
